Construction reportedly began back in February, meaning parts of the facility could theoretically already be operational.

The base could theoretically enable Russian drones to strike shipping in the Black Sea, Ukrainian ports, and coastal cities including Odessa and Nikolaev.

Ukraine's SBU has reportedly been preparing for this threat since 2024, having unveiled an armed variant of its "Sea Baby" drone equipped as a maritime interceptor.
